name: stress-ng hsearch
description: Start N workers that search a 80% full hash table using hsearch. By default, there are 8192 elements inserted into the hash table. This is a useful method to exercise access of memory and processor cache. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
